title: Metabase Dashboard Load Latency
dataSources: Superset logs (`superset:app`, Celery worker/beat), Metabase logs (`metabase:app`), Redash query logs, app repository tables (query cache, dashboard views), embedding/SDK error events via HEC.
app: Apache Superset / Metabase / Redash application logs via Universal Forwarder or container stdout; Celery worker metrics and app repository databases via Splunk DB Connect.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=metabase:app event=dashboard_load
| eval duration_s=round(duration_ms/1000,2)
| stats count as loads, p95(duration_s) as p95_s by dashboard_name
| where p95_s>8
| sort - p95_s
description: Computes Metabase dashboard load latency and flags dashboards slow enough to hurt self-service adoption.
value: Slow dashboards undermine a self-service BI rollout; per-dashboard latency shows what to cache or optimise.
implementation: Ingest Metabase logs; schedule daily; review slow dashboards; enable model/result caching.
visualization: Table by p95 latency, load-time trend.
grandmaExplanation: We time how long Metabase dashboards take to open so slow ones get improved.
